system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Ring of Spell Storing or another ring). You believe it is the ring it seems, and see its powers work when nothing happens.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
system.unidentifiedDescription:
Stores up to 5 levels of spells. Any spellcaster can cast spells into it; the wearer can cast a stored spell as an action, using the save DC of the original caster.

Rarity: Rare
